evidence.title: Honda Launches Florida Marine Office
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Honda Motor Co., Ltd., in coordination with American Honda Motor Co., Inc., just opened its Florida Marine Office (FMO) for Honda Marine, a division of Honda Power Sports & Products (PS&P), at Honda Motor Co., Ltd., in coordination with American Honda Motor Co., Inc., just opened its Florida Marine Office (FMO) for Honda Marine, a division of Honda Power Sports & Products (PS&P), at the company’s existing R&D Test Facility in Grant-Valkaria, Florida. [e001:f02] The office brings together Honda global and regional teams in a market-critical hub near U.S. boat builders, dealers, customers and real-world operating conditions. [e001:f03] “The Florida Marine Office is a strategic investment in how Honda Marine develops products and supports the people who sell and use them,” said Josh Matthews, Director, Honda Marine Division, in a news release. [e001:f04] “The Honda Marine strategy continues to focus on disciplined growth—bringing the right technology, dependable performance and a stronger ownership experience to boaters and boat builders. [e001:f05] By connecting our company’s global engineering expertise with real-world insight from within Florida, we can accelerate rigging and validation work, strengthen our large-outboard capabilities and respond more quickly to the changing needs of the U.S. market.” A Strong Marine Foundation The new FMO builds on a strong foundation of nearly two decades of specialized marine research within Honda R&D Americas and the broader global Honda R&D network, according to the company, centered at the existing, 11,000-square-foot waterfront Honda Marine facility, located on the Intracoastal Waterway in Grant-Valkaria, Florida. [e001:f06] Operational since December 2008, the site has supported hands-on market research, engine testing, software design and data acquisition across Honda outboards ranging from 2.3 to 350 horsepower. [e001:f07] Most Honda outboard engines sold in the United States undergo evaluation at the facility to help optimize fuel efficiency, throttle response and marine reliability. [e001:f08] Leading the product planning, field engineering and development teams for the new Honda FMO are Go Tanaka and Chad Nere, who emphasize the importance of locating the team in Grant-Valkaria. [e001:f09] “By locating global and regional resources together, the new Honda FMO creates a tighter connection among product planning, development, market feedback and validation—shortening the path from insight on the water to practical solutions for boat builders, dealers and customers,” said Tanaka, Chief Engineer, American Honda Motor Co., Inc., and Nere, Honda Marine Department Manager, Honda PS&P Development Division, in the release. [e001:f10] Across 23 R&D facilities nationwide, Honda teams advance mobility and power products through full-vehicle engineering, design, proving-ground evaluation, artificial intelligence, advanced technology research and specialized product testing. [e001:f11] Within that larger enterprise, the Florida Marine Office serves as a focused marine hub: on-water evaluation and local market knowledge from the United States can inform global planning and engineering, while expertise and resources from Japan can be applied more directly to U.S. product, rigging and customer-support priorities. [e001:f12] The Honda Florida Marine Office initially includes existing Florida-based Honda R&D associates, Honda Motor associates assigned from Japan, and two newly created Honda PS&P associate positions, according to the company. [e001:f13] “The new Florida Marine Office represents a strategic investment in the future of Honda Marine and our broader vision for a more integrated Power Sports & Products organization in North America,” said John Stevens, Vice President of Honda PS&P Business and Sales, in the news release. [e001:f14] This positions Honda Marine for sustained growth while delivering the products our customers want.” Located at 6545 S U.S. [e001:f15] Highway 1, in Grant-Valkaria, Florida, the Honda Marine testing facility earned LEED Gold certification from the U.S. [e001:f16] More recently, the Honda Marine division's engineering and service focus—largely validated by testing done at the Grant-Valkaria site—earned Honda Marine the prestigious 2025 Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) Award from the National Marine Manufacturers Association, according to the company.

evidence.title: F1 Singapore Grand Prix LIVE: Updates from FP1 ahead of sprint qualifying
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The 17th round of the 2026 Formula 1 season takes place at the Singapore Grand Prix, with this weekend marking the latest sprint event of the campaign. [e002:f02] The original night race on the calendar, Singapore has been a mainstay on the F1 calendar since it was introduced in 2008 and remains one of the most popular events on the schedule. [e002:f03] This year's Singapore Grand Prix marks the first time a sprint has been held at Marina Bay, meaning this weekend's schedule will differ from the usual order. [e002:f04] Just one practice session will be held before sprint qualifying concludes Friday's action. [e002:f05] Andrea Kimi Antonelli comes into the Singapore weekend with an 84-point lead in the championship following a second-place finish last weekend at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia. [e002:f06] A DNF for his Mercedes team-mate George Russell has all but ended his title hopes, while the Briton will start the Singapore GP from the back of the grid due to a power unit penalty. [e002:f07] Mercedes will run different car packages in Singapore to better understand the update it introduced at Sepang. [e002:f08] Antonelli will have the new parts, while Russell will use the old package. [e002:f09] Russell won last year's Singapore GP. [e002:f10] Max Verstappen will hope to break his Singapore duck and continue his winning form in 2026, after securing his first victory of the campaign in Malaysia. [e002:f11] Ferrari won in Singapore in 2023 and returns to Marina Bay after a podium finish at the Bahrain GP. Honda unlock performance with under the radar engine update
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The Spaniard was competitive throughout the weekend, qualifying in a season-best P12 before climbing the field on Sunday – overcoming a strategic error by starting the race on dry tyres. [e003:f02] To some extent, the AMR26’s aerodynamic efficiency played an important role – something which has been a relative strength since the Hungary upgrade. [e003:f03] However, the Honda engine was slightly stronger than in previous rounds, crucial at a circuit like Kuala Lumpur with several long straights. [e003:f04] This was thanks to an ADUO upgrade that went under the radar. [e003:f05] Image Credit: Aston Martin F1 Media Portal Aston Martin and Honda’s fine-tuning It was the Dutch GP that saw Honda introduce their first long-awaited upgrade via ADUO – the FIA’s mechanism for Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities. [e003:f06] There was intense speculation about how much performance this upgrade would unlock – with the consensus being that this updated power unit was three tenths better than its predecessor. [e003:f07] However, the Japanese engine is still over a second off the pace, something which is particularly painful at more energy-demanding circuit layouts. [e003:f08] With that said, Honda also outlined they would introduce small updates in 2026 if they did not take resources away from their development for next year. [e003:f09] Honda managed to find an improvement that met this criteria, via the introduction of a turbocharger in Madrid: “So Zandvoort is the first event we introduced the spec 2 engine. [e003:f10] “So we introduced an updated turbocharger to improve boost following and we confirmed the effect in Baku where boost following is quite important.” Image Credit: Aston Martin F1 Media Portal Big changes for 2027, optimisation of current package Fundamentally, the second Honda ADUO update was relatively small and focused more on efficiency than pure horsepower. [e003:f11] However, just because an update is relatively small in terms of lap-time does not mean it should not be pursued. [e003:f12] Honda’s strategy until their big engine changes for 2027 is to optimise their current operating systems and find any lap-time that is within each. [e003:f13] Shintaro Orihara, Honda’s Chief Engineer, outlined a similar sentiment: “So the updated turbocharger will help driveability, but also give us some gain on energy management. [e003:f14] The British team have not received hundreds in millions of investments to be so far away from the front-runners. [e003:f15] Honda have also proven capable of recovering a significant engine deficit, even (in the late 2010s) at a time when the top manufacturers were not restrained by ADUO and budget cap restrictions. [e003:f16] Therefore, any signs of life will be interpreted as reasons to expect a meaningful step forward from Adrian Newey’s team in 2027.

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e008:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e008:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e008:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e008:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e008:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e008:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e008:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e008:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e008:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e008:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: SpaceXが米携帯キャリア参入へ、800MHz帯の取得合意で屋内を補う地上網も計画
evidence.body: [e001:f01] SpaceX は2026年10月8日、米投資会社Grain Managementが保有する、米国全土を対象とした 800MHz 帯の周波数免許を取得する合意を発表した。 [e001:f02] 最大 14MHz 幅の低周波数帯を確保し、衛星通信と地上の携帯通信網を組み合わせた「Starlink Mobile」を、米国の大手携帯キャリアに対抗できるサービスへ発展させる計画だ。 [e001:f03] SpaceXは 取得に関するFCCへの提出資料 のIV.Bで、次世代Starlink Mobile衛星網の認可内容を変更し、 800MHz 帯を衛星からの地上通信補完（SCS：Supplemental Coverage from Space）にも利用するための申請を行う方針を示している。 [e001:f04] FCCが1万5,000基の衛星網を認可、800MHz帯の取得には追加手続き FCCは10月6日、SpaceXが計画するスマートフォンとの直接通信向け衛星網について、 1万 5,000基の配備と運用を条件付きで認可した。 [e001:f05] ただし、この衛星網の認可と、今回発表された 800MHz 帯の取得合意は別の案件だ。 [e001:f06] 対象 10月8日時点の状況 残る手続き・条件 スマートフォンとの直接通信用の 1万 5,000基の衛星網 FCCが10月6日に条件付きで認可 衛星の配備・運用と、周波数ごとの認可条件の順守 Grainが保有する 800MHz 帯免許 SpaceXが免許群を取得する契約を締結 FCCによる免許移転の承認など 800MHz 帯を使った衛星通信 SpaceXが衛星網の認可変更を申請する方針を表明 衛星から同帯域を利用するための追加認可 EchoStar 由来の 2GHz 帯など FCCが5月12日に2段階の免許移転を承認 信託からSpaceXへの最終移転など、周波数利用に関する条件 出典： Grainの取得合意発表 、 SpaceXのFCC提出資料 、 FCCの10月6日の命令 、 FCCの5月12日の命令 。 [e001:f07] それぞれの認可対象と取引の進捗を整理したものであり、すべての計画が一括して承認されたことを示すものではない。 [e001:f08] そのGrainが、約2カ月後の10月8日に、取得した 800MHz 帯の免許群をSpaceXへ売却することで合意した。 [e001:f09] AT&T 、T-Mobile、 Verizon の3社は10月1日、地上の通信網が届きにくい地域で衛星通信を利用しやすくするための 共同事業契約を締結した 。 [e001:f10] 今回の取得合意が重要なのは、 衛星事業者だったSpaceXが、圏外での通信を補う立場から、通常の携帯回線を提供する事業者へと進出する可能性が高まった点 にある。 [e001:f11] そのため、T-MobileとSpaceXが今後全面的に提携を解消すると判断する根拠はない。 [e001:f12] KDDIは2026年8月10日、SpaceXとの間で次世代衛星「Starlink Mobile V2」のサービス提供契約を締結し、9月15日に発表した。 [e001:f13] 一方、 NTTドコモ も8月14日、 Starlink Mobile V2を利用する次世代サービスの計画 を発表した。 [e001:f14] ただし、今回SpaceXが取得を計画している 800MHz 帯の周波数免許は、米国内で利用するためのものだ。 [e001:f15] Starlinkは日常の携帯回線になれるのか SpaceXの10月8日の発表では、米国内での全国的な商用サービス開始日や料金体系は示されていない。 [e001:f16] 今回の800MHz帯取得合意は、SpaceXが衛星通信だけに依存せず、地上の携帯通信網も自ら整備する方針を明確にした点で重要だ。

[e002:f15] The SpaceX Dragon is the only U.S. vehicle capable of transporting astronauts to and from the space station. [e002:f16] Standing nearly 27 feet tall and about 13 feet wide, Dragon capsules can carry up to seven astronauts into orbit, though[most of SpaceX's Crew missions](http:// which are contracted with NASA, feature a contingent of four.

evidence.title: Musk Calls Out 'Real Boss' Ambani as Starlink India Launch Stalls
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Elon Musk targets Indian billionaire Ambani over Starlink's regulatory delays Elon Musk just escalated his war of words with Indian regulators, directly targeting billionaire Mukesh Ambani in a heated exchange over Starlink's stalled India launch. [e003:f02] After five years of regulatory compliance, Musk's satellite internet service remains blocked from the world's largest democracy, setting up a high-stakes showdown between two tech titans that could reshape India's digital infrastructure landscape. [e003:f03] The gloves are officially off between two of the world's most powerful tech moguls. [e003:f04] Elon Musk didn't mince words when he took direct aim at India's richest man, Mukesh Ambani, over Starlink's prolonged regulatory struggles in the country. [e003:f05] The Tesla CEO's pointed question - whether Ambani is the 'real boss of India' - cuts to the heart of a brewing battle that goes far beyond satellite internet. [e003:f06] Musk's frustration boiled over after Starlink spent half a decade navigating India's complex regulatory maze, only to find itself still locked out of the market. [e003:f07] Yet the launch remains indefinitely delayed, leading Musk to suggest that powerful business interests might be pulling strings behind the scenes. [e003:f08] Mukesh Ambani controls Reliance Industries, which operates Jio, India's largest telecom network with over 400 million subscribers. [e003:f09] Starlink's satellite internet technology poses an existential threat to traditional telecom infrastructure, potentially bypassing the massive ground-based networks that Ambani has spent decades building. [e003:f10] The regulatory standoff reflects deeper tensions about foreign tech companies operating in India. [e003:f11] But Musk's direct challenge to Ambani suggests this goes beyond standard regulatory caution into the realm of protecting domestic business interests. [e003:f12] When Ambani speaks, Indian policymakers listen. [e003:f13] If regulators cave to domestic pressure and continue blocking Starlink, it could signal that foreign tech companies will always play second fiddle to local champions. [e003:f14] But if they allow the service to launch, it could open the floodgates for other international satellite internet providers. [e003:f15] By publicly questioning Ambani's influence, Musk is essentially daring Indian officials to prove their independence from corporate pressure. [e003:f16] Musk's direct challenge to Ambani forces Indian policymakers to choose between supporting domestic champions and embracing global competition.

evidence.title: SpaceX、Starlinkのスマートフォン直接接続でFCC承認 最大1万5000機運用へ
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 他社からの周波数借り受け義務も免除し、自社周波数の活用を認めた。 [e004:f02] SpaceXが、Starlinkのスマートフォン直接接続サービスの拡大に向け、重要な規制上の承認を得た。 [e004:f03] 他の移動通信事業者と別途契約を結ばずに、自社の周波数を活用できる道も開かれた。 [e004:f04] Business Insiderが7日（現地時間）に報じたところによると、米連邦通信委員会（FCC）は、SpaceXが同サービス向けにStarlink衛星を最大1万5000機配備・運用することを承認した。 [e004:f05] あわせてFCCは、1社以上の移動通信事業者と周波数の賃貸借契約を結ぶ必要があるとする規定も免除した。 [e004:f06] これによりSpaceXは、同サービスで自社周波数を利用できるようになった。 [e004:f07] 今回の決定により、SpaceXは既存の移動通信事業者のインフラへの依存を抑えながら、無線通信事業の拡大を進めやすくなる。 [e004:f08] FCCは承認決定の中で、SpaceXの衛星配備が競争を促し、より多くの地域で利用者の選択肢を広げることで、通信サービスの普及拡大につながるとの見方を示した。 [e004:f09] この決定を受け、SpaceXとVerizon、AT&T、T-Mobileといった米主要通信事業者との競争への影響が焦点となる。 [e004:f10] 一方、既存の通信事業者は現時点で、衛星サービスの競争力を高く見積もっていない。 [e004:f11] ダン・シュルマン氏は先月、Goldman Sachsのカンファレンスで、Starlinkを含む低軌道（LEO）衛星事業者が自社のブロードバンド事業の成長に与えた影響について、「ほとんど見られなかった」と述べた。 [e004:f12] さらに、中期だけでなく長期的にも、衛星サービスを「実質的な競争相手」とは見ていないとした。 [e004:f13] 今回のFCC承認は、Starlinkが衛星ベースの接続サービスを既存の移動通信事業者の補完にとどめず、独自の無線通信サービスへ広げるうえで、制度面の追い風となる。 [e004:f14] 今後は、SpaceXが衛星配備とサービス拡大をどのペースで進めるのか、また既存の移動通信事業者がどう対応するのかが、米通信市場の重要な変数となりそうだ。

evidence.title: UVI Falcon 2027 review: hybrid synth workstation gets another tasty free update
evidence.body: [e009:f01] UVI Falcon is different: since 2015, this hybrid synth workstation has received regular major updates at no cost. [e009:f02] Last year , they changed the naming convention to include the upcoming year; consequently, last year’s update was named “2026.” Now, UVI Falcon 2027—the next major free update—is here, massively expanding the synth’s capabilities once again. [e009:f03] It’s also on sale now for 50% OFF plus a 1+1 Expansion sale . [e009:f04] Falcon isn’t a simple synth; it’s a true hybrid sound-design workstation environment. [e009:f05] A multitude of synthesis methods, paired with advanced sample engines, has formed Falcon’s foundation since its initial releases. [e009:f06] Virtual analog, FM, multi-sample granular, additive, physical modeling synthesis, drum synthesis… just to give you a glimpse of the engine’s massive oscillator scope. [e009:f07] With Falcon 2027, they’re continuing this effort to make it more hands-on while taking its sound design capabilities even further. [e009:f08] The best news: this update is free for all users, again! [e009:f09] UVI Falcon 2027 Welcome to Falcon 2027, the update that will hopefully see you through well into next year. [e009:f10] That makes it clearer what UVI Falcon 2027 includes. [e009:f11] Deeper Sample Playground UVI Falcon 2027 also introduces new powerful tools for working with samples. [e009:f12] UVI is gifting Falcon even more effects in 2027, because more is better. [e009:f13] Version 2027 adds five new creative effects , three sound refining tools , and two utilities , all part of the FX engine. [e009:f14] As noted earlier, Falcon 2027 has gained a West Coast oscillator called West Folder. previous_updates.summary: SpaceXがIPO投資家へ示した軌道データセンター構想について、地政学アナリストのPeter Zeihanは、1GW施設の組み立てにStarship約500回の打ち上げが必要と試算した。 宇宙では放射線遮蔽とGPUの排熱が課題となり、Wood Mackenzieは1GW施設の総費用を約1700億ドル、地上設備の約3倍と見積もった。 予測市場では1MWの軌道データセンターが2029年1月までに稼働する確率を14％と評価する。 SpaceXは地上側ではAnthropicと月額12億5000万ドルの計算能力契約を結んでいる。

evidence.title: VEON Brings Starlink’s Satellite-to-Mobile Service to South Asia with Banglalink launch
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Bangladesh becomes the first country in South Asia to offer the service, keeping customers connected beyond the reach of mobile networks Dhaka, New York and Dubai [9 October 2026] — VEON Ltd. (Nasdaq: VEON) , a global digital operator, today announced that Banglalink, its operator in Bangladesh, has launched a satellite-to-mobile service powered by Starlink, the world’s largest direct-to-device satellite network, making Bangladesh the first country in South Asia to introduce the service. [e004:f02] The service is designed to keep customers connected during emergencies, natural disasters and prolonged power outages, when conventional networks may be disrupted. [e004:f03] A 4G phone and a Banglalink sim is needed to access the service. [e004:f04] Customers can access the service through MyBL, Banglalink's super app, and it will soon also be available on the RYZE app, Banglalink's AI-powered, youth-focused , sub-brand. [e004:f05] That’s the kind of impact VEON exists to deliver for people in Bangladesh and across our markets,” said Kaan Terzioglu, CEO of VEON Group. [e004:f06] Adding satellite-to-mobile extends Banglalink's reach beyond what towers alone can cover and makes our network more resilient. [e004:f07] Being first in South Asia is a milestone, but what matters to us is how many people it helps when they need it," said Johan Buse, CEO of Banglalink. [e004:f08] The launch supports VEON's strategy of extending access to connectivity and digital services across emerging markets through a combination of terrestrial and satellite infrastructure. [e004:f09] In 2025, Kyivstar, VEON's digital operator in Ukraine, launched Starlink services, making Ukraine the first country in Europe to deploy the technology commercially. [e004:f10] This was followed by the launch of Starlink services by Beeline Kazakhstan in September 2026. [e004:f11] Together, the launches in Ukraine, Kazakhstan and Bangladesh demonstrate how VEON is extending connectivity beyond the reach of traditional mobile infrastructure, supporting customers in both underserved and hard-to-reach areas while strengthening network resilience during emergencies and periods of disruption. [e004:f12] About VEON VEON is a digital operator that provides connectivity and digital services to over 150 million connectivity users and more than 228 million digital customers. [e004:f13] VEON is listed on NASDAQ. [e004:f14] As a fully owned subsidiary of VEON, a Nasdaq-listed global digital operator, Banglalink remains committed to driving innovation and building a brighter, more inclusive future for Bangladesh. [e004:f15] Forward-Looking Statements This release contains “forward-looking statements,” as the phrase is defined in Section 27A of the U.S. [e004:f16] Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, including in relation to Banglalink's Starlink launch as well as the VEON group's DTC strategy.

evidence.body: [e005:f01] SpaceXによると、新しいコンステレーションは最大150Mbpsの5G速度を提供する予定で、現在のネットワークの約4Mbpsと比べて大幅な向上となる。 [e005:f02] 米連邦通信委員会（FCC）は10月6日、SpaceXに対し、Starlink Mobile向けの次世代衛星15,000機の打ち上げと運用を許可した。 [e005:f03] 同規制当局はまた、SpaceXが地上の移動体通信事業者との周波数リース契約なしに、衛星を通じて無線サービスを提供することを可能とする免除措置を発出した。 [e005:f04] この承認と免除措置により、SpaceXが消費者に直接電話サービスを販売する規制上の道筋が開かれた。 [e005:f05] これらの衛星は、現在のStarlink Mobileサービスを支えている周波数である、T-MobileのPCS Gバンド（1910〜1915MHzおよび1990〜1995MHz）でも運用できる。 [e005:f06] SpaceXはEchoStarの周波数でテストを行うことはできるが、買収の第2段階（2027年11月30日完了予定）が完了するまで、それらを完全に利用することはできない。 [e005:f07] SpaceXは2025年9月、約170億ドルで周波数を購入することに同意した。 [e005:f08] FCCは5月にこの譲渡を承認したが、24億ドルのエスクロー条件を付した。 [e005:f09] 取引完了時点で、SpaceXは初代の次世代Starlink Mobile衛星の打ち上げを終えている見込みだ。 [e005:f10] 地上インフラと業界の反応 SpaceXは、衛星と低コストのフェムトセルを組み合わせる計画だ。 [e005:f11] T-Mobileはまた、T-Satelliteの存在感を低調に意味、他の衛星事業者と提携する可能性も示唆している。 [e005:f12] 未解決の問題 FCCは、競合衛星事業者や環境団体からの反対にもかかわらず、申請の大半を承認した。 [e005:f13] SpaceXは米国で2020〜2025MHz帯を、米国外で1429〜2690MHz帯の範囲を申請していた。 [e005:f14] T-MobileのSpaceXとの初期提携は先行者利益を与えたが、FCCの免除措置はその地位を弱めている。 [e005:f15] EchoStarとの周波数取引が完了し、SpaceXが新しい衛星を打ち上げる今後2年間が、ダイレクト・トゥ・コンシューマーモデルが大規模に機能するかどうかを示す。 [e005:f16] 新世代衛星の初回打ち上げと、サービスがT-Mobileの提携を超えて展開する際にSpaceXが発表する価格設定の詳細だ。

evidence.title: Telecom stocks drop as SpaceX acquires spectrum for Starlink
evidence.body: [e006:f01] The Elon Musk-led space company will pay about $8B in cash for the assets to the seller, private-equity firm Grain Management, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter. [e006:f02] Telecom shares dipped in after-hours trading, with T-Mobile TMUS , Verizon VZ , and AT&T T all down roughly 6%. [e006:f03] The three carriers formed a satellite-focused joint venture in May that some market participants believe is intended to respond to the ​threat from SpaceX. [e006:f04] Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed. [e006:f05] "This prime low-band spectrum addresses one of the key remaining technical gaps that will pave the way for Starlink Mobile to become a major mobile carrier in the US," the company said. [e006:f06] Once SpaceX SPCX receives final FCC approval, Starlink Mobile will deploy a flexible architecture combining its satellite-to-mobile constellation in space with an advanced terrestrial deployment that can seamlessly connect devices everywhere. [e006:f07] Combining nationwide low-band airwaves with space-based capacity positions Starlink Mobile to bypass traditional cell towers and challenge major wireless carriers on coverage and in-building signal. [e006:f08] Disclaimer Content provided by Seeking Alpha is intended for information purposes only, and that Seeking Alpha does not offer any personalist investment advice and is not a licensed securities dealer, broker, US investment adviser or investment bank.

evidence.title: SpaceX agrees to acquire frequencies for Starlink Mobile in the US
evidence.body: [e007:f01] The deal covers up to 14 megahertz of paired spectrum in the 800 MHz band and requires final approval from the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC), Anadolu Agency reports . [e007:f02] Indoor coverage SpaceX said the low-frequency spectrum should help address a key technical issue: such signals can penetrate obstacles, including walls, and provide connectivity inside buildings. [e007:f03] According to the company, most existing mobile devices already support this band. [e007:f04] Frequencies in the 800 MHz band will complement Starlink Mobile’s global mid-band spectrum in the 2 GHz range. [e007:f05] SpaceX plans to use it in the United States to provide high network capacity. [e007:f06] More current news is available on the Telegram channel Telegram . [e007:f07] Approval for new satellites After receiving regulatory approval, SpaceX plans to combine its direct-to-cell satellite constellation with ground infrastructure. [e007:f08] The company intends to provide connectivity indoors, outdoors, and in areas without cellular network coverage. [e007:f09] Separately, SpaceX said that the FCC this week approved its application for a next-generation Starlink Mobile satellite constellation, allowing the launch of 15,000 satellites for global operations in the 2 GHz band. [e007:f10] According to the company, V2 Starlink Mobile satellites will have more than 100 times the capacity of the current generation and will support high-speed connectivity to mobile devices without modifications to them. evidence.title: ZIPAIR、AIを活用した高精度な乱気流予測を導入し安全な運航支援を強化 Starlinkと連携
evidence.body: [e001:f01] この新機能は、エムティーアイが提供する航空気象サービス「3DARVI」に搭載され、同日よりZIPAIRのフライトにおいて利用が開始されています。 [e001:f02] 航空機の運航において、風速や風向きの急激な変化によって生じる乱気流は、発生場所やその強度を事前に正確に予測することが困難な気象現象とされてきました。 [e001:f03] 乗客や乗務員の安全を確保し、快適なフライトを提供するためには、このリスクを早期に把握し、飛行経路や高度の選定などの運航判断に活かすことが航空会社にとって重要な課題です。 [e001:f04] 今回導入されたBlueWXの「AI乱気流予測」は、AIの深層学習技術を駆使して数値気象予報や過去数年分の乱気流発生データ等を解析し、将来の乱気流発生リスクを高精度に予測するサービスです。 [e001:f05] 開発過程においては約4年間にわたり、数千名のパイロットや運航管理者によるトライアル運用が行われ、運航現場の評価を取り入れながら予測精度と信頼性が大幅に高められました。 [e001:f06] ZIPAIRでは、機内に導入されているStarlinkの高速通信環境を活かし、飛行中のコックピットからリアルタイムでこの予測情報を確認できる環境を整えています。 [e001:f07] また、搭載先であるエムティーアイの「3DARVI」を通じて、気象現象と飛行ルートをひと目で3Dで視覚的に把握できるため、パイロットは既存の気象情報や航空情報とあわせて一元的に状況を確認し、乱気流リスクを踏まえた的確な運航判断を下すことが可能となります。 [e001:f08] この3社の連携により、最新のAI気象予測と運航現場が直接結びつき、運航判断のさらなる高度化と安全な航空運航のサポートが実現します。 [e001:f09] 各社は今後も、実運航から得られる知見やフィードバックをシステムの精緻化や製品開発に活かし、航空運航における安全性、快適性、および業務効率の向上を目指して取り組みを推進していくとしています。 [e001:f10] ZIPAIR、パートナー企業4社と連携した脱炭素推進の特別デカール機をお披露目 本日より全路線で運航開始 ZIPAIR、ヒューストン線1月以降搭乗分の販売開始とシンガポール・ソウル線の12月増便を発表 ZIPAIR、2027年夏スケジュールのサンフランシスコ・ソウル線を販売開始 ラスベガス・オーランドへの直行チャーター便も運航決定 Related posts: ZIPAIR/ジップエア、2021年冬スケジュール期間搭乗分を販売開始 ジップエア、2022年1月14日より東京/成田～ロサンゼルス線を増便 ジップエア、2023年1月11日より東京/成田～サンノゼ線を増便 ジップエア、アジア路線を対象に片道5,250円からのブラックフライデーセールを開催中※燃油サーチャージ不要。
